fingerprint_definition: SHA256 of the lexicographically sorted relative paths to the 36010 identified catalogue-like files, joined with newline and terminated with newline; not a checksum of FITS contents
complete_random_mode: per-realization shuffled random FITS and separately released tracer/cap common random FITS
interpretation: The public release has matching LRG and ELG data and corresponding random filenames for all realization IDs 0001-1000 in both caps. This confirms filename-level pairing only; it does not certify mock contents, selection or covariance.
